'').toLowerCase() ||\n      undefined,\n  })\n  @Public()\n  @Mutation(() => AuthPayload)\n  async login(\n    @Args('input') input: LoginInput,\n    @Context() context: GqlContext,\n  ): Promise<AuthPayload> {\n    // PERF-MEDIUM-003: tier-0 login latency SLI. Both were removed. These tests make re-introduction loud:\n20\t * adding the method back fails CI until a deliberate architectural decision\n21\t * (a \"new tenant + first admin\" onboarding saga) replaces it.\n22\t */\n23\tdescribe('Public surface contract (SEC-CRITICAL-001 / MT-LOW-001)', () => {\n24\t  it('AuthResolver does NOT expose a register mutation', () => {\n25\t    const descriptor = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(AuthResolver.prototype, 'register');\n26\t    expect(descriptor).toBeUndefined();\n27\t  });\n28\t\n29\t  it('AuthenticationService does NOT expose a register method', async () => {\n30\t    const { AuthenticationService } = await import('../services/authentication.service');\n31\t    const descriptor = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(AuthenticationService.prototype, 'register');\n32\t    expect(descriptor).toBeUndefined();\n33\t  });\n34\t\n35\t  it('tenantBySlug implementation returns only name/slug/logoUrl keys', async () => {\n36\t    // The leaky row the resolver must NOT forward: a full tenant entity whose\n37\t    // `id`/`status`/`plan` are exactly the fields MT-LOW-001 removed from the\n38\t    // public payload. `stub<Tenant>` keeps those field names checked against\n39\t    // the real entity, so a rename cannot quietly turn this into a fixture\n40\t    // that proves nothing.\n41\t    const leakyTenant = stub<Tenant>({\n42\t      id: 'internal-uuid-must-not-leak',\n43\t      name: 'Acme Farms',\n44\t      slug: 'acme',\n45\t      logoUrl: null,\n46\t      status: TenantStatus.ACTIVE,\n47\t      plan: TenantPlan.ENTERPRISE,\n48\t    });\n49\t    const resolver = new TenantResolver(\n50\t      collaborator<TenantService>(\n51\t        { findBySlug: jest.fn(() => Promise.resolve(leakyTenant)) },\n52\t        'TenantService',\n53\t      ),\n54\t      // The audit and command collaborators are unreachable from the public\n55\t      // query; an empty `collaborator` makes any future call to them a named\n56\t      // failure instead of a silent `undefined is not a function`.\n57\t      collaborator<AuditLogService>({}, 'AuditLogService'),\n58\t      collaborator<TenantProvisioningCommandService>({}, 'TenantProvisioningCommandService'),\n59\t    );\n60\t\n61\t    const result = await resolver.tenantBySlug('acme');\n62\t\n63\t    // WHY exact-keys assertion: a future field addition to the public payload\n64\t    // must be a deliberate decision, not an accidental spread. The exact key\n65\t    // set also structurally proves `id` and `status` are absent.\n66\t    expect(Object.keys(result).sort()).toEqual(['logoUrl', 'name', 'slug']);\n67\t  });\n68\t});\n69\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"48e44323-b856-43fe-826b-f63836c45826","uuid":"c570a466-3c45-4e6f-bdef-2a3918ab0484","timestamp":"2026-10-04T14:08:03.415Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/home/gharunner/actions-runner/_work/aquaculture_platform/aquaculture_platform/aria-worktrees/req-AIR-aria-consensus-arbiter-a2c9895abfae/apps/auth-service/src/modules/authentication/__tests__/public-surface-contract.spec.ts","content":"import 'reflect-metadata';\n\nimport { collaborator, stub } from '@aquaculture/testing';\n\nimport { AuditLogService } from '../../../audit/audit-log.service';\nimport { Tenant, TenantPlan, TenantStatus } from '../../tenant/entities/tenant.entity';\nimport { TenantResolver } from '../../tenant/resolvers/tenant.resolver';\nimport { TenantProvisioningCommandService } from '../../tenant/services/tenant-provisioning-command.service';\nimport { TenantService } from '../../tenant/services/tenant.service';\nimport { AuthResolver } from '../resolvers/auth.resolver';\n\n/**\n * Public-surface contract — SEC-CRITICAL-001 + MT-LOW-001 regression guards.\n *\n * WHY: the 2026-06-10 audit found the public `register` mutation accepted a\n * client-supplied tenantId with zero validation (anonymous cross-tenant\n * account injection), and the public `tenantBySlug` query leaked the internal\n * tenant UUID + lifecycle status — the exact harvest leg feeding the\n * injection. Both were removed. These tests make re-introduction loud:\n * adding the method back fails CI until a deliberate architectural decision\n * (a \"new tenant + first admin\" onboarding saga) replaces it.\n */\ndescribe('Public surface contract (SEC-CRITICAL-001 / MT-LOW-001)', () => {\n  it('AuthResolver does NOT expose a register mutation', () => {\n    const descriptor = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(AuthResolver.prototype, 'register');\n    expect(descriptor).toBeUndefined();\n  });\n\n  it('AuthenticationService does NOT expose a register method', async () => {\n    const { AuthenticationService } = await import('../services/authentication.service');\n    const descriptor = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(AuthenticationService.prototype, 'register');\n    expect(descriptor).toBeUndefined();\n  });\n\n  it('tenantBySlug implementation returns only name/slug/logoUrl keys', async () => {\n    // The leaky row the resolver must NOT forward: a full tenant entity whose\n    // `id`/`status`/`plan` are exactly the fields MT-LOW-001 removed from the\n    // public payload. `stub<Tenant>` keeps those field names checked against\n    // the real entity, so a rename cannot quietly turn this into a fixture\n    // that proves nothing.\n    const leakyTenant = stub<Tenant>({\n      id: 'internal-uuid-must-not-leak',\n      name: 'Acme Farms',\n      slug: 'acme',\n      logoUrl: null,\n      status: TenantStatus.ACTIVE,\n      plan: TenantPlan.ENTERPRISE,\n    });\n    const resolver = new TenantResolver(\n      collaborator<TenantService>(\n        { findBySlug: jest.fn(() => Promise.resolve(leakyTenant)) },\n        'TenantService',\n      ),\n      // The audit and command collaborators are unreachable from the public\n      // query; an empty `collaborator` makes any future call to them a named\n      // failure instead of a silent `undefined is not a function`.\n      collaborator<AuditLogService>({}, 'AuditLogService'),\n      collaborator<TenantProvisioningCommandService>({}, 'TenantProvisioningCommandService'),\n    );\n\n    const result = await resolver.tenantBySlug('acme');\n\n    // WHY exact-keys assertion: a future field addition to the public payload\n    // must be a deliberate decision, not an accidental spread. The exact key\n    // set also structurally proves `id` and `status` are absent.\n    expect(Object.keys(result).sort()).toEqual(['logoUrl', 'name', 'slug']);\n  });\n});\n","numLines":69,"startLine":1,"totalLines":69}}}

startTime;\n      const remaining = this.minLoginDurationMs - elapsed;\n      if (remaining > 0) {\n        await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, remaining));\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Accept invitation and set password\n   *\n   * SECURITY: All reads and the canBeAccepted() check are inside the transaction\n   * with SELECT FOR UPDATE to prevent TOCTOU race conditions (two concurrent\n   * requests both passing validation independently).\n   */\n  async acceptInvitation(\n    token: string,\n    password: string,\n    firstName?: string,\n    lastName?: string,\n    ipAddress?: string,\n  ): Promise<AuthPayload> {\n    // Execute all reads + validation + writes inside a single transaction\n    const result = await this.dataSource.transaction(async (manager) => {\n      // SEC-HIGH-158: the URL segment is resolved through the ONE resolver\n      // (ActionToken row id first, legacy raw token second) — the same path\n      // validateInvitation reads, so the two can no longer disagree.\n      const { actionToken, invitation } = await this.loadInvitationForSegment(\n        manager,\n        token,\n        'pessimistic_write',\n      );\n\n      if (actionToken && !actionToken.isActive()) {\n        throw new BadRequestException('Invalid invitation token');\n      }\n\n      if (!invitation) {\n        throw new BadRequestException('Invalid invitation token');\n      }\n\n      if (!invitation.canBeAccepted()) {\n        if (invitation.isExpired()) {\n          throw new BadRequestException('Invitation has expired');\n        }\n        throw new BadRequestException('Invitation cannot be accepted');\n      }\n\n      // Find user by invitation token hash (within transaction). Invitation\n      // redemption runs BEFORE tenant context is established — the token IS\n      // the pre-tenant credential, so the lookup scans across all tenants by\n      // construction (auth-service is the one service where cross-tenant auth\n      // flows are first-class; tenantManagerRepo cannot be used here).\n      const user = await this.preTenantAuthRepository(manager, User).findOne({\n        where: { invitationToken: invitation.token },\n      });\n\n      if (!user) {\n        // SECURITY: Generic message to prevent token enumeration\n        throw new BadRequestException('Invalid or expired invitation');\n      }\n\n      // Update user with password and clear invitation token\n      user.password = password; // Will be hashed by BeforeUpdate hook\n      user.invitationToken = null;\n      user.invitationExpiresAt = null;\n      user.isEmailVerified = true;\n\n      if (firstName) user.firstName = firstName;\n      if (lastName) user.lastName = lastName;\n\n      await manager.save(User, user);\n\n      // Update invitation status\n      invitation.status = InvitationStatus.ACCEPTED;\n      invitation.acceptedAt = new Date();\n      invitation.userId = user.id;","numLines":80,"startLine":895,"totalLines":2189}}}
